peg.peg_mechanism_score_basis: Raised from 4.5 to 5.5 on 2026-09-21 when the HISTORY was measured, not on new argument. The observed record is strong and verified: 283 daily archive samples across the token's entire life (2025-12-11 → 2026-09-20, no gaps) over BOTH venues it has ever had — UniV3 DUSD/USDC slot0 while liquid, Curve get_dy thereafter. Worst reading ever 0.999673 (2026-06-30); total lifetime excursion from par 3.23 bps. CoinGecko's ATL $0.9717 on 2026-03-12 is REFUTED — UniV3 quoted 0.999998 that day at block 24,637,909 with unchanged liquidity. ⚠️ HELD AT 5.5 AND NOT HIGHER BECAUSE THE MECHANISM IS UNCHANGED AND STILL WEAK: the dominant 88% tranche has NO THIRD-PARTY ARBITRAGE CHANNEL. FixedPriceStrategy at exactly 1e18, zero fee, AccessMode.PERMISSIONED since inception, a single SWAPPER_ROLE holder (the treasury Safe), 16 lifetime swaps all originated by it, zero third-party swaps ever. The 12% CDP tranche is mechanically sound. Alto's own lending hardcodes DUSD at $1, which insulates the protocol but means it never prices a depeg. Peg support is DISCRETIONARY, not mechanical. Below crvUSD (6.0), which has an open PSM and a hard redemption.
peg.peg_mechanism_score_persistence: filtered — mechanism design plus a measured lifetime record, not a spot quote
peg.authored_vs_band_note: ⚠️ A MEASURED BAND WILL READ HIGH ON THIS ASSET, AND IT IS NOT A FEED ERROR — it is the axis definition diverging from the evidence. A band scores the OBSERVED DEVIATION, and the observed deviation is excellent (3.23 bps over ten months), so a deviation band lands around 8/10. The authored 5.5 docks the MECHANISM, and the reason the two cannot be reconciled is stated in the score basis: a clean record on a discretionary mechanism is evidence about the OPERATOR, not about the mechanism, and none of the 283 samples covers a stressed period. Where they disagree the authored figure governs; the band should render as the measured record, labelled as such.
peg.current_deviation_is_a_premium_note: ⚠️ READ THE SIGN BEFORE READING THE SIZE. DUSD currently quotes ABOVE frxUSD — mid 1.002081 frxUSD (+20.8 bps), executable +19.5 bps at $1k — measured at block 26,053,165 on 2026-09-25. An absolute-deviation band will score this like a 20 bps depeg. It is not one: it is a pool-composition artifact. The Curve pool is 23.33% DUSD / 76.67% frxUSD, so DUSD is the SCARCE coin and prices above the abundant one. DUSD cannot be worth more than frxUSD — it is 88% a 1:1 frxUSD claim — so the premium is an artifact, not a valuation. Any alert on this asset must be signed and must read pool_token_share_pct alongside price; the composition leads the price.
peg.premium_cannot_close_by_trading_note: ⚠️ NEW MEASUREMENT 2026-09-25, and it bounds the peg risk from the ONLY direction that matters. Bringing the pool to par requires 911,971 DUSD sold into it — 1.11x the ENTIRE 821,855 DUSD supply, of which only 23,937 sits outside the pool. So par is UNREACHABLE by trading existing supply; it requires the treasury to mint ~912K new DUSD, more than doubling supply. And the incentive to do so is negligible: integrated over the whole balancing trade the arbitrageur extracts 582 frxUSD, 1.70 bps of the pool. Method: StableSwap-NG get_D/get_y/dynamic-fee reimplemented locally and verified against the pool's own get_dy to the WEI on 8 probes ($1k–$2M, both directions) before use. ✅ DOES NOT MOVE THE SCORE — it reinforces 5.5 by showing the premium is inert rather than by re-arguing the mechanism, which is unchanged.

Capital in Re's Insurance Capital Layer is allocated to fully-collateralized reinsurance via licensed insurers, held in a U.S. §114 Reinsurance Trust; the liquid sleeve runs an Ethena basis / T-Bill strategy. A NAV-tracking vault share, not a $1 peg — and the share price is ADMIN-WRITTEN on SharePriceCalculator. Primary redemption is non-U.S. persons only and pays sUSDe on Mainnet (USDC on Avalanche). ⚠️ NOT Resupply's reUSD (0x57aB1E00…), a different issuer and a different asset.

Published figure is the last rung that cleared, so the true depth sits inside the bracket and above what is shown. SLIPPAGE CONVENTION: TOTAL over the fill (not marginal impact at the margin), measured against this venue's own smallest quoted rung. ⚠️ That reference EXCLUDES the smallest rung's own spread, so the figure is price impact and NOT the holder's all-in cost — which is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Smooth growth $1.00 -> $1.08 over 11 months, consistent with target rate; early-launch dips (Jul-Aug 2025) imply ~1-3% discount-to-NAV at worst, near-zero from late 2025. Feed: NAV 1.09955 against market 1.09993, a +3.5bp premium. ⚠️ CAPPED BELOW 'VERY TIGHT' AND THE REASON MUST TRAVEL WITH THE NUMBER: this reflects OBSERVED PERFORMANCE, NOT STRESS-RESILIENCE PROVEN. History is 11 months, insurance loss patterns are back-loaded, and the structural setup that could produce a deeper detachment remains in place. No stress event has tested the exit asymmetry.

registry.name: fxUSD (f(x) Protocol)
registry.description: f(x) Protocol's Ethereum stablecoin, backed by wstETH and WBTC pledged against leveraged long positions. Read the measured per-pool collateral ratios and debt shares: aggregate coverage can hide concentration in the custodial WBTC leg. Protocol redemption follows a Curve EMA state gate; it is not an at-will holder exit or a guaranteed floor. fxSP holds a large share of supply, and supply outside fxSP is not necessarily freely tradable float. Shares upgrade governance with fxSAVE; see dated authority evidence and the newer authored assessment.

Read the per-pool split.

peg.volatility_score_basis: CUT 6.5 -> 5.5 on 2026-10-04, AND NOT BECAUSE ANYTHING DETERIORATED -- every figure that justified the 6.5 improved and the row was still wrong. The 2026-09-14 note deferred this re-rate and named its conditions ('STRC concentration and the exit asymmetry, both unchanged'); ONE OF THOSE PREMISES IS FALSE. RESOLVED: '~-9% below NAV' -> -1.34% (nav_spread_pct); 'NAV ~1.376' -> 1.436830, strictly monotonic across 722 readings with zero drawdown; 'underlying undercollateralized ~95%' -> 101.5602%. Accrual is real and rate-consistent at 13.51% 30d / 14.25% 7d against STRC's 11-15% indicated, and the one-way ratchet held through the June event. WHY CUT ANYWAY: THE 6.5 CREDITED NAV SMOOTHNESS THAT IS SUBSTANTIALLY DEFINITIONAL. apyUSD's NAV IS total_assets/shares -- PegTracker flags the same tautology on share_coverage_tautological_pct ('Definitional, not measured ... it carries no information about backing'). Zero drawdown in 722 readings is a property of the formula as much as of the assets. AND THE MARK IS WEAK THREE WAYS: 52.18% of the STRC bucket ($80,169,860) is marked at an UNDISCLOSED issuer price; the verifiable 47.82% is marked off a venue holding ~$371K against a $70.8M position; and THIS EXACT NAV HAS ALREADY BEEN INFLATED ONCE FROM THIS EXACT SOURCE -- the June post-mortem records that Apyx's own dashboard showed an inflated NAV from a STRCx pricing bug. Precedented, not hypothetical. AND THE ONLY INDEPENDENT PRICE SIGNAL HAS NEVER AGREED WITH THE NAV: 0 of 722 readings at or above it on the DEX measure, 0 of 702 on CoinGecko. TWO FIELDS BOTH LABELLED discount-to-NAV DIFFER BY ~190BPS ON THE 30-DAY MEAN (-1.674% DEX vs -3.58% CoinGecko); THE DEX MEASURE BINDS because that is where a holder transacts, and the 2026-09-29 FIRED alert at -1.38% is that measure -- now -1.336%, essentially unchanged, NOT recovered. Second false premise: capture is 55.24%, not 'roughly a third'. NOT cut further because the accrual, rate consistency and ratchet are genuinely verified.

The 2.5 priced a sustained ~-18% dislocation (~$0.82) that has RESOLVED: live -1.1013% at $0.988987, current-regime band -0.53% to -1.95% over 293 hourly readings since 2026-09-22, with 0% below -2% against 88% in the 431 readings before. A one-sided discount that never touches par through a full recovery of its collateral is the market pricing the absence of an arbitrage path -- which CONFIRMS this axis rather than refuting it, since backing closed on the balance sheet while the discount stayed open, and those are only jointly consistent with no atomic redemption. Mechanism unchanged: off-chain USDC settlement, approved-counterparty RFQ, no on-chain redemption. DO NOT READ 3.5 AS PRICING AN ADOPTED REDEMPTION VALUE -- the 'Apyx 2.0' floor is evidenced only by a 2026-06-16 blog post and is NOT re-verified as of 2026-10-04; that is the cheapest measurement that could move this axis.
